Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Merger Deal Settles With 12 States

Paramount Global has reached a settlement with 12 U.S. states that were challenging its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. The states agreed to drop their legal challenges after securing assurances regarding job preservation and news safeguards. The deal, valued at approximately $111 billion, is now proceeding with fewer obstacles.
